title: Futuristic landing page redesign for public homepage

requirements.summary: Redesign the public homepage ("/") into a clean, futuristic, user-friendly landing experience while preserving existing routing/auth redirects and navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: When not authenticated, visiting "/" shows a modern landing page with clear hierarchy (hero, supporting sections) and obvious primary call-to-action.
The landing page is responsive (mobile → desktop) and maintains good spacing/typography with a clean, futuristic look.
All user-facing text on the landing page is in English.
No backend changes are required for the homepage redesign.

file_operations.description: Replace the current dashboard-like layout with a more polished landing layout (hero + multiple supporting sections), keeping TanStack Router navigation behavior intact and ensuring English-only copy. Use existing shadcn-ui primitives already in the app (e.g., Card, Button) to build the new layout. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Confirm the existing redirect behavior for authenticated users ("/" → "/dashboard" or "/admin") remains unchanged while the unauthenticated experience renders the redesigned LandingPage.

requirements.summary: Expand LandingPage content to include a benefits/features section and a prominent next-step CTA section that routes users to "/signin" (Internet Identity flow).
acceptanceCriteria: LandingPage includes at least: (1) an improved hero section, (2) a benefits/features section, and (3) a prominent CTA section that routes to "/signin".
The CTA(s) use existing navigation patterns (TanStack Router navigate) and remain functional.
The new sections use existing UI components (e.g., Card, Button) and match the clean/futuristic aesthetic.

file_operations.description: Add new landing sections beyond the current hero + 4-step grid: (1) benefits/features section using Card-based feature tiles and (2) a clear next-step section with a primary CTA that navigates to "/signin" via TanStack Router navigate. Use existing shadcn-ui components (Card, Button) and existing lucide icons where appropriate; do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update/extend centralized landing-page copy constants to support the new hero messaging, benefits/features text, and next-step CTA wording (English only), and migrate LandingPage to consume these constants to keep text consistent.

requirements.summary: Apply a consistent clean/futuristic visual theme for the redesigned homepage using existing Tailwind tokens and dark-mode defaults without altering immutable UI component sources.
acceptanceCriteria: The homepage design uses a cohesive visual system (consistent spacing, type scale, and accent usage) and does not introduce conflicting styles.
No changes are made to read-only UI component sources under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing components only).
The resulting page remains accessible (semantic headings, readable contrast, focus-visible states preserved).

file_operations.description: Refine typography hierarchy (semantic headings), spacing, and accent treatments for a cohesive futuristic look using existing Tailwind tokens (chrome/cyber palette) and preserving focus-visible/accessibility patterns; ensure sections are responsive and readable on dark mode.

Add/adjust small reusable global utility classes for subtle futuristic accents used by the LandingPage (e.g., faint gridline overlay helper, soft glow treatment, section background treatments) while staying aligned with existing Tailwind token variables and not introducing conflicting global styles.

requirements.summary: Add and wire a generated static hero background image as a subtle futuristic backdrop in the homepage hero (no backend serving).
acceptanceCriteria: A generated image file is added under frontend/public/assets/generated and is referenced directly by the LandingPage hero section.
The hero background image loads in production builds without requiring any backend endpoints.
The background image remains subtle (does not reduce text readability) and scales well across viewport sizes.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static image asset: Abstract clean futuristic grid/glow hero background, dark with subtle chrome accents (landing-hero-bg.dim_2400x1350.png).

Reference the static hero background image at frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-hero-bg.dim_2400x1350.png in the hero section (preferably via the existing getAssetUrl helper so it works with optional CDN base), and layer it subtly behind content with an overlay/gradient to preserve text readability across viewport sizes.

Ensure LandingPage can use the existing getAssetUrl utility for resolving the hero background asset path consistently (including optional CDN configuration), without introducing any backend dependency.
